groups.saying_opens: نصلي يوم الجمعة خلف أمراء فيؤخرون الصلاة
ذكر لي أن نبي الله صلى الله

notes: Two sayings, each stored with its own chain (owner ruling 6). The first: Abu al-Aliya asks Abdullah b. al-Samit, who says he asked Abu Dhar, who says he asked the Prophet: Abu Dhar is the last link (rule 6). «قال لي» and «قلت لعبد الله» make Abdullah a link (rule 5).
The second saying «قال وقال عبد الله ذكر لي أن نبي الله ... ضرب فخذ أبي ذر» has no named transmitter: «ذكر لي» is an unnamed gap (rule 8). The Prophet is the end of both chains.
The dash-enclosed «- قال -» is a Muslim editor marker, not a link.
